responsibility: Provides the core target configuration header for the RL78 port, defining ABI properties, data-model sizes, register numbering and classes, register allocation order, calling-convention and frame macros, address-space identifiers, assembler and linker specs, predefined preprocessor macros, exception/unwind settings, and target hook macros that connect GCC’s generic backend interfaces to RL78-specific behavior. It is the central architectural description header consumed by the rest of the RL78 backend.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the central target configuration header for the RL78 port, expressing architecture properties through macros, register/class definitions, ABI constants, and GCC interface bindings. Unlike rl78.cc it does not implement the hook logic, unlike rl78.md it does not describe instruction patterns, and unlike rl78.opt it does not declare user-visible target options.
